asset: character motion clips (Mixamo) + generated Animator controller
why: CLAUDE.md §3 requires provenance for every generated or sourced asset. The 15 motion FBX had none — the only record of what each action was cut from lived in a code table. This file is that record.

source.license: Mixamo standard license — free use within a project for a licensed Adobe account holder; the FBX ship inside the game build only, never as standalone animation assets.
source.acquisition: downloaded interactively from mixamo.com; there is no non-interactive API, which is the blocker on boss-specific motion (see openQuestions).

pipeline.reskin: tools/blender/reskin_character.py rebinds each mesh to the mixamo humanoid skeleton with automatic weights (CLAUDE.md §3). The original's procedural region-split skinning is banned — it caused the mesh breakage.
pipeline.retarget: Assets/Editor/CharacterImportPipeline.cs imports every clip as Humanoid; Unity retargets onto each avatar, so ONE clip set serves all 12 meshes.
pipeline.controller: BuildController generates Assets/Art/Motion/CinderActor.controller: any-state -> state on `action Equals <row index>`, 0.08 s crossfade, one-shots exit to idle at exitTime 0.95. Row index IS the animator condition value (ClipTableTests pins it).
pipeline.measurement: Assets/Editor/ClipWindowProbe.cs — SampleAnimation onto the humanoid rig at 1/60 s, tracking the fastest hand relative to the hips. Run: bash tools/unity_batch.sh method CinderCourt.EditorTools.ClipWindowProbe.Run

trimRationale: A Mixamo clip is a standalone performance (settle, wind up, strike, recover). The View holds some poses for a FIXED window and drops them when it closes, so an untrimmed clip shows only its preamble. attack was trimmed 2026-02; show and cast on 2026-08-09 after measurement found Mutant Roaring playing ~20% of a 5.42 s roar inside a 1.1 s window, and the cast clip ~11% of 2.71 s inside 0.30 s. Reaction clips were measured and deliberately left whole: hit/bighit preambles are 2.2%/5.3%, and avoid/defence are not squeezed into fixed windows at all.

removed.reason: Zero references in Assets/, tools/ or docs/ since the foundation commit 7fc22c0 — never in the Clips table. 213,120 bytes of LFS payload in every checkout for a clip nothing could play.

openQuestions: Boss motion differentiation: all 12 meshes share ONE controller, so a stage boss swings and reacts exactly like a grunt — identity is carried only by mesh, scale and tint. The fix is append-only (bossattack/bossshow rows resolved in ActorView, the mechanism attack2/attack3/cast already prove) but needs NEW Mixamo clips, and mixamo.com has no non-interactive download. Blocked on an operator Adobe session, not on design.

tools/blender/reskin_all.sh now lists all 12 ids with recovered paths, but it CANNOT RUN: ~/orca/Abyssal-Surge was rebuilt as a Unity project and no longer carries assets/motion or assets/mesh. Every id misses, including the original 8. The shipped FBX are the artifacts of record until that library is restored.
